chunk_findings.detail: The old test required a leading-hyphen id to be created, claimed, updated, and shown through the real parser. The rewrite rejects `-x` at `task add` and then drives the non-hyphen id `x`, so the function name no longer matches what it checks. The new test only `shlex.split`s `LW.Drop("-x", ...).command()` and never calls the CLI. If `.command()` already emits `ddflow update --globs b.py -- -x` (as the previous test assumed before `run_cli`), this assertion passes on the unfixed tree even when claim/update/show still treat `-x` as an option. That is not a regression that fails before the fix.
